rules.title: Annual General Adjustment (AGA) rent ceiling increase
rules.requirement: Each year the Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board sets an Annual General Adjustment that eligible landlords may use to raise the permanent rent ceiling on rent-controlled units, based on 65% of the increase in the Bay Area Consumer Price Index (CPI) for the prior July-June period. For 2026 the AGA is 1.0%, applicable no earlier than January 1, 2026.
rules.key_value: 65% of CPI increase (July-June), capped/set annually; 2026 AGA = 1.0%

coverage_conditions.notes: Applies to units subject to Berkeley rent control (rent-ceiling units); excludes units where the tenancy began on/after 2025-01-01 with rent set under Costa-Hawkins vacancy decontrol.

rules.exemptions: Does not apply to adjust the rent of tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 and whose rent was set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act (state vacancy-decontrol law). Conditions for qualifying for the increase and required tenant notice are set out in Rent Board Regulation 1148.
rules.interaction: The 65% of CPI formula applies within Berkeley's local rent stabilization system and operates alongside the state Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act, which removes certain post-2025 tenancies from the local rent ceiling.
rules.quoted_span:
adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow 
eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than 
January 1, 2026
rules.conflict_note: Document is a public notice summarizing the Board's adopted AGA Order/Regulation 1148 rather than the municipal code text itself; exact effective date of the underlying 65%-of-CPI formula (Nov. 2004 ballot measure) is approximate.
